description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取恒生行业分类在指定日期的成分股列表。可按行业代码批量查询获取指定时间样本信息，返回信息包括每只成分股的代码、地区和市场信息。当用户需要查看某行业成分股列表、获取成分股清单或确认股票行业分类时，调用此接口。
description.en: Fetch HSI industry classification constituent list at a specified date, returning constituent stock code, area code, and market. Supports single or multiple industry codes. Date can be specific or 'latest'. Used when user needs HSI industry constituents, retrieves constituent lists, or confirms a stock's industry classification.
